RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-11-17)
- Second straight down day: Dow -1.6%, S&P -1.0%, Nasdaq -0.7%. Tech glitch worries (a reported NSA network outage) and AI selling hit CRM -9.6% ahead of Thursday's Anthropic debut.
- Managed care cracked on CMS's proposed CRUSH anti-fraud rule, which allows audit clawbacks back to 2018: UNH -5.4%, HUM -3.9%. We pulled the HUM idea at midday and the whole group stays in avoid through 11/20.
- Our ideas: ACM held its earnings gap and closed +11.4% ($80.78), so that conditional long is now logged. DIS faded to -1.9% after its beat, so that one is voided.
- NVDA (-0.4% to $155.46) reported after the bell. Revenue was about $109B, in line, and the January-quarter guide (Street ~$125-130B) plus the Kress call decide tomorrow. Chip and AI-hardware avoids stay on until the tape digests it.
- Next: TGT, LOW, and TJX report before the open Wednesday, FOMC minutes at 2 PM, PANW after the close, WMT Thursday morning, and the Anthropic IPO Thursday.
